bestBets.overview: RAW UMBER improved sharply at his second start producing a dominant all the way win. On that occasion W Pike went on and he fired him straight to the front and from there he gave nothing else a look in. If he repeats that effort he wins again. ROCKTEX has run well in both starts this time in. He should get every chance from a good draw and run well. CHIX OBSESSION found the line well on debut and should appreciate the rise in trip.  LUCKY EIGHTY EIGHT next best.

raceTips.comment: Raw Umber trialled very nicely under Giaan O’Donnell leading into his debut where he never really got a crack at them despite being well supported in betting. Pike jumped on for his second run, took him to the front and he absolutely bolted in eased down in what was as polished and easy an early season 3YO victory you’ll see. Simon Miller happy to document post-race he feels he could be a Derby type of horse further down the track so you’d think off those comments the further the better for him and he only rises 1kg at the weights here off that win last start. Should really take beating again. Chix Obsession trialled nicely and then just find the 1000m a bit slick on debut at Bunbury when really catching the eye with his work late and through the line (fastest L400m/2nd quickest L200m of the entire meeting). Straight to 1400m here no surprise off that, looks a nice type. Lucky Eighty Eight has had the run at 1400m and was really solid behind The Persian God who looks a nice one at big odds in 3YO Saturday company. Brad Parnham on and well placed back into the midweeks. Rocktex backs up off the 6 days after a solid effort into 2nd behind a talented debutant in Cassandra, may have been ridden a touch close?

RAW UMBER rolled his way to the top second-up and that was the last they saw of him. He has a beautiful big reaching action and covered the ground effortlessly to win by a soft 3L. He only rises 1kg start to start and takes on another majority field of maiden gallopers. Doesn’t seem to be anything that will have the intention of holding him out early and if they allow him to dictate terms to them, it’s likely game over. LUCKY EIGHTY EIGHT comes through a Saturday race and finished fourth behind The Persian God, Western Splendour and Gods Hammer. Improving type. ROCKTEX was no match for the highly impressive debutante Cassandra last Thursday. Trying hard. AXOPAR will look to tow ball the fav and follow his every move.

bestBets.overview: SOMETHING ROYAL is rock hard fit and racing well. W Pike retains the ride and she should get every chance from her inside draw. GREAT PROMISE rolls forward and will give a big kick. She looks very close to a win. EARTH GOD has ability and and attacks this first-up with the benefit of two trials. SNIP OF ROMANCE next best.

raceTips.comment: SOMETHING ROYAL showed a bit of versatility last start. Prior to that she seemed a simple jump and run animal but as is so often the case when Pike jumps aboard, they try something new and figure something out. She ended up three deep cover and kept coming behind Bosisto at Bunbury. She’s drawn far better here and can settle just behind speedy trio Snip Of Romance, Great Promise and Earth God. Stalks and can zap them late. SNIP OF ROMANCE had a tongue tie added and the blinkers removed last start and it paid dividends. She scored an over due win and after the Natika Riordan claim drops 3kg into this. EARTH GOD is really well placed by Team Gangemi having contested higher graded races at his last 8 outings since scoring a C3 win at Northam. GREAT PROMISE tries hard but continues to find one better.

Something Royal has turned a corner for the new team. CL3 winner at Northam two back before putting in a huge effort in defeat at Bunbury when parking deep the trip and still managing to almost reel in Bosisto late, getting home in the best L200m of the entire meeting. Pike sticks and drawn to lob right on the back of what looks a very spirited speed battle with a cutaway in play if need be, she’s absolutely humming. Great Promise I actually think could well be suited dropping back to the 1000m. Has speed, has a sharp turn of foot and is bursting to win one. Earth God resumes for an in-form yard off a couple of trials where he wasn’t asked to do a great deal. He’s well placed resuming in a CL3 as a horse that has multiple times placed in Saturday Grad company. Winkers on first time and didn’t trial in them, smells like a bit of intent. Snip Of Romance was too speedy for them last start, she’s extremely quick but this race does have a bit more depth to it into CL3 company and she’ll need to elevate. A positive is the use of the claim this time around leaves her with just 52.5kgs on her back.

bestBets.overview: JEMCONI showed ability in her initial preparation and she attacks this first-up with the benefit of two nice trial efforts. W Pike goes on and think he she rolls forward and will be hard to run down. HOT CHIX LANE found the line well first-up and should appreciate the rise the in trip. ZALI'S GIFT has ability and she has been tuned up for her return with two trials. She will park on the speed and give a kick. NEUBRONNER ran well on debut at big odds.

raceTips.comment: Hot Chix Lane had some big wraps on her early in her career and has clearly had a few issues behind the scenes as she’s only been raced sparingly but I thought her run fresh from a wide gate over an unsuitable 1000m at Bunbury was terrific getting home late in some very strong late sections. Out to 1200m here and while never ideal losing the Wizard, goes around each-way and should only improve out of that effort. Won’t be a maiden long. Jemconi is the way the Wizard goes on return for Simon Miller after showing a bit of promise in her debut campaign of racing. Trial was only slowly run but it was a sharp piece of work and she’ll enjoy a gun run from the draw. Just feel she’s short enough at close to even money? Zali’s Gift has trialled well for her return but draws wide and has had a few chances now. Mon Visage is a nicely bred 3YO filly on debut with the light weight who caught the eye late at her most recent trial outing.

HOT CHIX LANE went back first-up and attacked the line hard behind Arties Eclipse and stablemate Bubbles In Rio. She was first-up, no trial off 199 days and so naturally you would expect her to be fitter and stronger here second-up. She’s drawn middle of the line and has shown that she’s capable of going forward or back in her races but with the rail at 16m, with a cutaway and up to 15ml of rain on race day, wider might be better? Loved her return. JEMCONI went around favourite on debut and was afforded no luck behind Door Buster and Energetic. Trials this time around have been encouraging and she’s got both a barrier and Pike in her favour. NEUBRONNER went around 150-1 on debut which seemed harsh considering her trials were both quite good? ZALIS GIFT ran four consecutive minors last prep from 1200 to 1500. Just a matter of time until she wins one.

bestBets.overview: Keen on TRULY LOYAL in this maiden. He was beaten as an odds on favourite on debut and immediately tipped out for a spell. He's changed stables since, has trialled in superb order and W Pike rides. BIFF BAM BOOM makes his debut on the back of two nice trial efforts and looks the danger. CALL ME INVINCIBLE is closing in on a win. if he gets any luck from his wide draw he will be in the finish. SWEET ISSY battled on solidly after being caught being wide throughout.

raceTips.comment: Truly Loyal trialled like a bomb leading into his debut performance where he went around $1.85 in the market and just got keen back in the field from a wide gate. Tipped straight out, trialled like a bomb again in rain-affected conditions (bodes well for Wednesday given the forecast), Pike rides from a good draw and much prefer the 1200m as a kick-off point for him. Think he’s very promising. Call Me Invincible is knocking on the door. Barrier a blow but put in a very good effort last start in a high rating 1200m maiden contest. Biff Bam Boom makes his debut off a sharp recent trial win where he showed some very good early toe to lead. Looks a talent but Pike has opted for the cerise & white galloper. Champagne Talks stuck on well in a fast run maiden last start at Pinjarra and can roll forward here with some intent from that low draw.

TRULY LOYAL won a 950m Lark Hill maiden by 3L leading into his debut at Ascot in April and was all the rage, getting into odds on and then nothing went right from start to finish. He ended up in an awkward spot in running, he over raced really badly through the early and middle stages and then he had nothing to offer late in a race completely dominated from on top of the speed. Really nice trial again leading into this preparation and like the fact he’s kicking off at 1200m rather than 1000m. More time to build through his gears. Keen. BIFF FAM BOOM is on debut for Team Williams and is drawn alongside the favourite. Led and won a 950m trial but did get things awfully cheap. CALL ME INVINCIBLE is on the 7 day spin from a fast run race here last Wednesday. ROCKY TWO had three trials in Mornington before being moved over to Perth.

bestBets.overview: MARCOS was scratched Saturday on vets advice. Provided he is ready to roll think he takes plenty of beating on the back of two strong efforts this time in. VIENNA CALLING shook her maiden with a strong last start win. She can go on with the job. EXPRESSO TIME got the job done at Northam despite enduring a tough run. TIGER TANK next bets.

raceTips.comment: MARCOS broke his maiden at Belmont over 1200m beating Pucker Up, Manhattan Squeeze, Profit Motive and Super God in a race that seemed to have a bit of depth to it. He then went to Northam into a C1 and was backed as if unbeatable before going toe to toe with Flying Maradona down the home straight in a race where they stopped the clock 5.5L faster than average. He’ll concede them a head start here but with the conditions of the day, that might not be a bad thing. ESPRESSO TIME has been tough in both runs back this campaign. Clearly returned far stronger. VIENNA CALLING ran third behind then 2 year olds Properata and Star Martini first-up and then was the beneficiary of a 12/10 ride from Brad Parnham to break her maiden at Pinjarra on the Scarpside. STAR SUPREME is a wet tracker. One last consideration.

Map could prove to be the difference here between the two market fancies. Vienna Calling bumped into an in-form Properata first up over the 1000m before stepping to 1200m last start at Pinjarra and was able to break through posting a figure almost 5L faster than maiden class average. Has to do it again here with a couple more kgs but she looks as though she has more wins in-store and she should have a map advantage on Marcos with where he’s drawn. At the price discrepancy, happy to lean her way. Marcos won well on return before bumping into an aptly-named Flying Maradona at Northam last start who franked that form by running well subsequently in Saturday company. Just looks a sticky map for a horse sub even money in what could be some pretty inclement conditions, just mindful he could be overbet but can absolutely win. Espresso Time was tough maiden win at Northam sitting deep the trip but punching on to score late. Has speed and gives the impression still a bit of upside as well. One Target is 1/24 but going super much like all of Chris Stelmach’s at the moment and draws the inside on a cutaway day with Nottle engaged, can absolutely be a force here at double figures if the inside isn’t quicksand by this stage of proceeedings.

bestBets.overview: HYPE MACHINE stormed home first-up producing an impressive win at big odds. If he can repeat that effort he goes close again. COSMO RULER attacks this off a six week let-up. She is a mare on the rise and Pike rides. SOUTH HOBA attacks this first-up with the benefit of a nice trial effort.  COSMIC GEM has been sound in both starts this time in.

raceTips.comment: Cosmo Ruler gets here 6 weeks between runs but she’s got plenty of ability, she’s lightly raced and she should lap up the presented conditions with what looks a really favourable map in transit. Ticks a few fair few boxes. Cosmic Gem is building to a win, the map the concern? Broke maiden status on a very wet deck down at Albany so the conditions shouldn’t worry him too much. Abissi is a wet tracker who was a cracking return off a very long spell behind The Rocket 7 days ago but just mindful he could be a touch flat off such a big run, second up from a very long spell. If he’s taken no ill-effect, he’s right in this back into a CL1 and the middle of the track could be the place to be given the rain around. Rising Fame is also continuing to build into her campaign. She backs up from last Wednesday, drops back in class and could just about kick through to lead from that inside peg.

COSMIC GEM trialled well at Belmont leading into his return before being crunched in betting fresh ($8 into $3.80) and unfortauntely got trapped three deep the trip without any luck. Fought on bravely into third behind Lemmor Filou and Cable Rock and then again was hammered in betting at Bunbury, backed to beat progressive 4 year old Gods Cross who had clearly superior race form. Ended up in the worst part of the track on a day at Bunbury where you had to get wide and he was three back the fence. Complete forgive first-up and second-up. COSMO RULER is now 6 weeks between runs and was scratched at Pinjarra last Thursday with a hoof abscess. She’ll work her way through the grades but just wary of risk vs reward with the minor setback. HYPE MACHINE broke his maiden in style and got a decent push from both trainer and jockey post-race. SOUTH HOBA jumped under $4 at her WA debut. Now lands with Summer Dickson who is having another hot run.

bestBets.overview: RAINLINE went to Kalgoorlie last start and posted a deserving win. From a good draw she stalks the speed and goes close again. JAZALOT is in career best form. If he gets any luck from a wide draw he will be in the finish. CHOUX SHOE ran well and Pike retains the ride. BUNDABERG ran well first-up and draws to get every chance.

raceTips.comment: RAINLINE is just a model of consistency and you know what you’re going to get with her. She’ll park up close handy behind a strong tempo and she’ll be afforded every chance by an in-form apprentice whose 1.5kg claim won’t last much longer than September. Right grade, right map, right place, right time. OUR ROCKY BAY has been much better in his last three since the winkers went on and especially since they’ve returned to riding him for speed. Thought his last start effort when third behind Heaven Specified, I Love Ya Money and subsequent winner Publicise was really good. CHOUX SHOE will come into it if they overcook it.

Rainline is just going to get the world perfect run from the draw. She’s going super, she’ll lob right on the back of what looks a genuine tempo and she’s a proven weight carrier who hasn’t run a bad race all campaign. Rain won’t worry her, she’s in the zone and runs for Holly Nottle. Our Rocky Bay is back in good form. Was made to do a mountain of work to get across them last start in Saturday company from a wide gate and rolled them along 5L faster than average to the 600m as a result. Stuck on well considering and looks really well placed and weighted here dropping back into the midweeks with the last start form reference proving a handy producer since as well. Right race for him to nearly pinch if he gets through the expected going. Jazalot has been up for an eternity but has bounced back to some really good form at his last couple and will get to the middle of the track in the straight. Brad Parnham may have been the key to him. Choux Shoe will get back under Pike and look to blouse them late if they overcook with some weight relief.

bestBets.overview: SLICK was luckless first-up and then last time raced a bit flat in a better class of race than this. He will appreciate the drop in grade and rise in trip. BACK TO BONDI attacks this off a strong last start win. If he can find a spot over the speed without spending too much early fuel he will be hard to rundown. BUDERIM is another on speeder with claims. THE NUN didn't fire first-up. She is better than that and no surprise to see her improve sharply on that effort.

raceTips.comment: BACK TO BONDI was given a peach by Holly Nottle last Wednesday. He jumped into the slipstream of the leader from the 1200 to 600 and then presented on straightening to bound clear late by an extending 1.5L margin. He is on the second 7 day spin (third run in a fortnight) which is an ask and he returns to C3 grade but that looked a confidence boosting win of a horse who could hold form and continue his way towards Saturday grade. CHEETO steps out for the first time for new trainers Dan & Ben Pearce. You only need to go back two starts into a C3 1700 when third to Shimonoseki and Partay to make a case for him. SAFARI BOY was a cheeky run first-up at 100-1 at a distance short of his best, in a higher grade than this. IMPRESSIVE JEWEL is tracking along quite well and Sisu Spirit nearly came out of that event to win a 66+ on the weekend. Just query being fence in run by this stage of the day.

The Nun had excuses first up with the run she had on a very on-speed program at Pinjarra. Love the form she brings to the table from last prep as the horse I think has the most upside in this field and Justine Erkelens is very astute with her placement of horses so clearly there is an opinion straight to the mile here second up that she’s going to get a bit of ground. Big improver. Back To Bondi is off the 7 day spin from a dominant CL1 win last Wednesday given a peach from Holly Nottle. This is certainly harder and he’s drawn a lemon but there doesn’t appear to be a huge amount of speed in this so she should be able to get across and slide forward early doors. Runs in CL3 company prior to the win last start more than good enough to be measuring up in this. Safari Boy has come back enormous? Hugely cheeky run fresh at monster odds in a higher grade of race than this at 1400m off the back of a pair of very sharp trials I wasn’t sure he was capable of producing! Must for quaddie players at north of 30/1. Cheeto has his first run for team Pearce and his last two have been as luckless as they have been super runs in review. Intrigued to see what he can produce under new tutelage.
